modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow appropriate safety practices while working in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas
lift heavy objects safely using correct procedures
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person

modules.module_title: Emergencies, rescue and first aid procedures

pcs.pc_description: use appropriate type of fire extinguisher
apply appropriate rescue techniques during fire hazard
provide appropriate first aid procedure to victims wherever required eg.in case of bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock etc.
follow emergency procedures such as raising alarm, safe evacuation etc.
attend safety training and fire drills to respond promptly during an emergency
follow regular cleaning and disinfection practices at work place using appropriate techniques and materials
follow hand hygiene practices at work place using appropriate techniques and materials
report regarding the contagious illness of self or people in close contact
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
follow the fundamentals of 5S for housekeeping
ensure good housekeeping in order to prevent hazards and accidents
store the material, tools and equipment in the correct location and in good condition
segregate waste into different categories
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Communicate effectively with colleagues and others

pcs.pc_description: coordinate with colleagues to share work, as per the workload in order to achieve team goals
maintain clear communication with colleagues and others, wherever needed, through all means i.e. face-to-face, telephonic or written
adjust communication styles to reflect gender and persons with disability (PwD) sensitivity
respect all colleagues and co-workers
resolve conflicts by communicating with colleagues and other departments
identify work requirements by receiving instructions from reporting supervisor
escalate problems to supervisors that cannot be handled
report the completed work
interact with the reporting supervisor about any possible hazards and safety concerns

modules.module_title: Follow appropriate behaviour at work place

pcs.pc_description: extend help to people with Disability (PwD) at workplace, if required
empathize with people with disability
adopt a gender neutral behavior
adopt responsible and disciplined behaviours at the workplace

pcs.pc_description: read and interpret the checklist to identify the requirements of rigging job
identify tools, tackles, rigging equipment and accessories required during the rigging job
select and arrange the tools, tackles, rigging equipment and accessories as per the SOP and job requirements
prepare plan to carry out the rigging job considering the area of work and floor load bearing capacity
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for safe working during rigging work
check the tools, tackles, rigging equipment and accessories for any defects and that they are as per the required quality standards
identify and select hitches and knots based on the rigging requirements
identify hitch configurations and capacities on the basis of load specifications i.e. shape, weight etc.
select appropriate slings, wire ropes, and end terminations as per the requirement
report to stores in case of non-availability of tools & tackles or stock-out

pcs.pc_description: calculate the weight and volume of loads for carrying out rigging job
identify centre of gravity and lift points of the load
carry out pre-use inspection of rigging equipment and accessories
ensure hoisting/rigging activity is not performed under hazardous conditions e.g. close proximity to energised line
verify that all slings and hardware are rated more than the expected load
use padding to protect synthetic slings from damage
attach pulleys and blocks to fix overhead structure e.g. beams, equipment assemblies, valves etc.
provide necessary support and tie the load to be handled
control movement of heavy loads during lifting through narrow openings/confined space to prevent any lateral damage and for safe working
interpret hand signals / verbal directions from co-worker for moving loads
tilt, dip and turn suspended load to maneuver obstacles around the work place by using multi point suspension techniques
check the work pieces as per the work instructions for product quality
remove hoisting equipment, crane, chain blocks, pull hoists etc. from the work place
clean and store all the tools, tackles, equipment and accessories after completion of work
ensure that work site is left in clean and safe condition
